items.title: agent-desktop is still the fastest riser at 3,791 stars today
items.summary:
vercel labs' cli lets an agent drive desktop apps by reading their accessibility trees instead of guessing from screenshots.
it added 3,791 stars today and is now on 13,096 total, up about 1,100 since yesterday evening, with a push as recent as 23:16 utc.

items.title: scrapling holds second place with 1,658 stars today
items.summary:
scrapling wraps a single request, a stealth browser session and a full crawl behind one python api.
it added 1,658 stars today for 95,081 total and was pushed again late on tuesday night.

items.title: claude-code-game-studios keeps adding 1,182 stars for a 49-agent studio
items.summary:
the repo turns claude code into a pretend game studio with 49 agent roles, 72 workflow skills and a coordination layer.
it added 1,182 stars today for 34,776 total, though its last push was back on 19 october.

items.title: mattpocock's skills repo sits on 1,164 stars today
items.summary:
it is a plain folder of agent skills copied straight from the author's own dot-agents directory.
it added 1,164 stars for 311,622 total with no new commits since 1 november.

items.title: claude-mem stays at the top of trending with 1,139 stars today
items.summary:
claude-mem records what an agent does in a session, compresses it with a model and injects the useful parts later.
it added 1,139 stars for 112,060 total and was pushed at 03:30 utc today.

items.title: colibri adds 802 stars for running frontier moe models on one box
items.summary:
colibri streams mixture-of-experts weights from nvme and ram so a single machine can run models far bigger than its vram.
it added 802 stars today for 47,322 total and was pushed at 00:38 utc.

items.title: floci enters trending with 482 stars as a free aws emulator
items.summary:
floci is a local java emulator for aws services, pitched as a lighter drop-in for localstack-style testing.
it added 482 stars to reach 28,907 and was pushed at 03:26 utc today.

items.title: kronos enters with 503 stars as a foundation model for market data
items.summary:
it is an open-source decoder-only model trained on candlestick data from more than 45 exchanges to forecast price series.
it added 503 stars to reach 46,574, though the repo has not been pushed since april.

items.title: israeli officials say trump misspoke on ending aid by december
items.summary:
trump told fox on tuesday that he and netanyahu agreed months ago to stop paying israel $4bn a year by the end of 2026.
jerusalem post reports both staffs now say he misspoke, but they will not correct it on election day, and netanyahu's office still had no public comment.
items.change: officials now say trump misspoke and the correction is being held until after the midterms, while the 2018 mou still runs to 2028.

items.title: iran says a 'maximum deterrence' plan is ready for a new us attack
items.summary:
tehran says its military has updated target lists to cover us and israeli assets across a wider area and will respond immediately.
the irgc also claimed it downed two mqm-170 reconnaissance drones south of qeshm and an mq-9 east of hormuz.
items.change: tehran moved from promising a response to saying a named deterrence plan and expanded target lists are already in place.

items.title: trump says he has no immediate plan to strike iran
items.summary:
he told the financial times the us is 'not really in a war' with iran and that talks are 'getting everything we want'.
he still said the military is 'locked and loaded', while a senior iranian official told reuters the two sides are far from a deal.
items.change: trump shifted from 'no rush' before the vote to saying there may be no reason to restart strikes at all.

items.title: iran's security chief says the us reply is 'not convincing'
items.summary:
mohsen rezaei said washington has to answer all seven iranian conditions in full before the strait of hormuz reopens.
the demands run from ending the war on every front and lifting sanctions to compensation and recognition of iranian control of hormuz.
items.change: rezaei formally rejected the us counter-offer, and us cargo aircraft from fort bliss were tracked into israel with a third carrier due next week.

items.title: israel certifies its election result today with no bloc near 61 seats
items.summary:
likud's bloc has 53 seats, the eisenkot-led opposition 48 and the two arab lists 19, so herzog's consultations decide who tries first.
the opposition says it will act immediately to replace netanyahu, but it has not said how it gets past 60 without arab support.
items.change: the count is certified today, which starts herzog's formal consultations and a new knesset on 10 november.

items.title: yemen's government says 21 irgc and hezbollah experts run houthi operations
items.summary:
the interior minister listed 14 irgc and 7 hezbollah specialists spread across hodeidah, sanaa, saada, hajjah, amran and khokha.
he said their jobs now include planning missile and drone strikes, naval attacks and picking commercial ships as targets.
items.change: sanaa put a number and a map on foreign involvement for the first time, naming 21 people and six cities.

items.title: a tanker is hit by two unknown projectiles near hormuz
items.summary:
ukmto reported the strike as iran's parliament speaker said the ball is in america's court to prevent a wider war.
iran's parliament speaker says the ball is in america's court, and qatar says freedom of navigation there is non-negotiable.
items.change: a fresh tanker was hit on tuesday night, and iran is now floating a two-day reopening rather than a seven-day one.

items.title: israel warns washington that iran may use chemical weapons
items.summary:
a report cited by the jerusalem post says israeli intelligence passed the warning to the us in recent days.
us officials are said to be sceptical of the intelligence, and the claim has no independent confirmation.
items.change: a new israeli intelligence claim landed in washington, and us officials are reported to doubt it.

items.title: stock futures fall as democrats are projected to take the house
items.summary:
s&p futures are down 1.2% and nasdaq-100 futures 2.0% after the election desk called the house for democrats.
traders read a blue wave as more data-centre restrictions: coreweave is down 6% overnight and the solar etf is up 3.5%.

items.title: the s&p 500 rose 0.4% on election day while the dow slipped
items.summary:
the index closed at 7,568.92 and the nasdaq-100 at 28,180.26, up 0.68%, with the dow off 0.38% at 51,786.72.
the vix closed at 20.83, down 1.5% on the day, before futures turned lower overnight.

items.title: oil fell a second day and is flat overnight near $103 brent
items.summary:
brent settled at $103.60, down $1.17, and wti at $96.09, down 37 cents, as traders bet on a diplomatic settlement.
brent is at $103.28 this morning and wti at $95.61, with the eia reporting crude stocks at 18:30 riyadh.

items.title: amd beat and jumped 8% before the futures selloff dragged it back
items.summary:
third-quarter revenue and earnings came in above forecasts as data-centre revenue nearly doubled from a year earlier.
the stock was last up about 3% as index futures gave up their gains, so the beat is intact but the tape is not.

items.title: adp and ism services headline today's us calendar
items.summary:
adp employment lands at 16:15 riyadh with a 69k forecast after 90k last month, and the trade gap at 16:30.
ism services follows at 18:00 with a 54.8 forecast against 54.9, then eia crude stocks at 18:30.

items.title: mcdonald's and novo lead the morning, arm and qualcomm after the close
items.summary:
uber, cvs, emerson and datadog also report before the open, with mcdonald's the biggest name by market value.
arm, qualcomm, mckesson, mercadolibre and applovin report after the bell.

items.title: the 10-year yield fell below 4.91% as futures sold off
items.summary:
the note had closed near 4.95% and dropped more than 4 basis points overnight as money moved into bonds.
that is the opposite of the equity move, which usually means the market is buying safety rather than growth.

items.title: liverpool take a perfect european record to kuyt's fenerbahce
items.summary:
liverpool have won all three league-phase games and sit second in the table before tonight's 20:45 riyadh kickoff in istanbul.
dirk kuyt's fenerbahce have one win in five and lost his first match in charge, so the form book points one way.

items.title: gravenberch is out of istanbul with a heel injury
items.summary:
he did not travel after feeling the problem in the arsenal warm-up and iraola says it is a day-to-day pain issue.
the coach would not rule him out of sunday's trip to crystal palace, but said he had not improved much since the weekend.
items.change: he was a bench option on sunday and is now out of the squad entirely, with trey nyoni set to deputise again.

items.title: szoboszlai and munoz are back in a 22-man squad
items.summary:
both returned against arsenal and travelled to turkey, while frimpong, ekitike and leoni are still out.
iraola is expected to shuffle after sunday's defeat, with trey nyoni pushing to start again in midfield.

items.title: barcola says liverpool still have no clear identity under iraola
items.summary:
the £123m winger told sky sports the side leans on long balls when he wants them playing through midfield.
all three of his goals came in the 6-3 win over lask, and he says his best version has not arrived yet.

items.title: mac allister says liverpool told him they did not plan to renew
items.summary:
he says the club made that clear last season, leaving him with a year and a half on a deal that runs to 2028.
he also said the new manager, new sporting director and incoming investors mean anything can happen; real madrid are the club linked.
items.change: mac allister put the no-renewal message on record himself rather than leaving it to briefings.

items.title: ziege backs frimpong and kerkez to come good at liverpool
items.summary:
the former left-back says both full-backs need time, having seen his own anfield spell end after one season.
that is punditry rather than a transfer report, so treat it as opinion rather than a live move.

items.title: arsenal's 1-0 win was liverpool's first home league game without a shot on target in 442
items.summary:
havertz scored on 16 minutes and an alisson error decided it, leaving liverpool fifth and nine points off the top.
it was arsenal's first league win at anfield since 2012.

items.title: iraola says he never asked for an explanation over the timber pull
items.summary:
he confirmed liverpool have had no word from the officials about the decision not to send off jurrien timber for dragging back isak.
he said he had two days between games and chose to prepare for fenerbahce instead.
